description: This Java class MockOnOffCluster represents a mock implementation of an On/Off cluster for a Zigbee device, providing methods to turn the device on or off, handle commands, and report attribute states.

classes.name: MockOnOffCluster
classes.description: A mock class simulating an On/Off cluster for testing and development purposes in Zigbee device integration.

methods.name: isOn
methods.description: Returns the current on/off state of the cluster.

methods.name: setOn
methods.description: Sets the device state to on or off and sends an attribute report if the state changes.

methods.name: getAttributeData
methods.description: Provides the attribute data for the given AttributeInfo, specifically handling the 'on' state.

methods.name: handleCommand
methods.description: Handles incoming command IDs to turn the device on or off.
